title: Pontryagin maximum principle for non-smooth state-constrained control problems over Wasserstein spaces
summary: We study a state-constrained Bolza optimal control problem governed by a non-local continuity equation in the Wasserstein space $\sP_2(\R^d)$. We develop a Pontryagin maximum principle for these problems in which both the cost functionals and the constraints are only locally Lipschitz, and the initial measure does not necessarily have compact support. To derive the main result, we introduce a notion of a Clarke-type deterministic subdifferential over $\sP_2(\R^d)$.
